package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func diagnosticEventTestResult(t *testing.T) DiagnosticAssessmentResult {
	t.Helper()
	id := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	r := DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", AttemptID: id, PlanID: id, PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy, BandPolicyVersion: DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicy, CourseContentRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), PlanDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), Correct: 2, Total: 3, Percent: 66, Band: "CORE", CompletedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 0, 0, 0, 123456000, time.UTC)}
	var err error
	r.ResultDigest, err = DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return r
}

func TestDiagnosticResultCommittedEventReferencesAndStableIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	r := diagnosticEventTestResult(t)
	request := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	event, err := NewDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(r, request)
	if err != nil || ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event) != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid event rejected: %v", err)
	}
	want := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte(SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted+":"+r.PlanID)).String()
	if event.EventID != want || event.CorrelationID != r.PlanID || event.CausationID != request || !event.OccurredAt.Equal(r.CompletedAt) {
		t.Fatal("event identity or canonical occurrence changed")
	}
	var envelope EventEnvelope
	if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var data map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil || len(data) != 4 {
		t.Fatal("data must contain exactly four references")
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"plan_id", "plan_revision", "plan_digest", "result_digest"} {
		if _, ok := data[key]; !ok {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s", key)
		}
	}
	second, err := NewDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(r, request)
	if err != nil || string(event.Payload) != string(second.Payload) {
		t.Fatal("rebuilding committed event changed payload")
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*DiagnosticAssessmentResult){
		func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) { r.AttemptID = r.StudentID },
		func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) { r.ResultDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64) },
		func(r *DiagnosticAssessmentResult) { r.CompletedAt = r.CompletedAt.Add(time.Nanosecond) },
	} {
		bad := r
		mutate(&bad)
		if _, err := NewDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(bad, request); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid authoritative aggregate admitted")
		}
	}
	if _, err := NewDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(r, " "+request); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("noncanonical causation admitted")
	}
	mismatch := r
	mismatch.AttemptID = r.StudentID
	mismatch.ResultDigest, _ = DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(mismatch)
	if _, err := NewDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(mismatch, request); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("self-consistent result with different attempt and plan admitted")
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticResultCommittedEventRejectsMalformedStoredPayload(t *testing.T) {
	event, err := NewDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(diagnosticEventTestResult(t), "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*IntegrationEvent){
		"unknown subject": func(e *IntegrationEvent) { e.Subject += ".extra" },
		"case alias": func(e *IntegrationEvent) {
			e.Payload = []byte(strings.Replace(string(e.Payload), `"plan_id"`, `"Plan_ID"`, 1))
		},
		"metadata":        func(e *IntegrationEvent) { e.CorrelationID = e.StudentID },
		"schema":          func(e *IntegrationEvent) { e.SchemaVersion++ },
		"unknown field":   func(e *IntegrationEvent) { e.Payload = append([]byte(`{"score":1,`), e.Payload[1:]...) },
		"duplicate field": func(e *IntegrationEvent) { e.Payload = append([]byte(`{"schema_version":1,`), e.Payload[1:]...) },
		"duplicate data": func(e *IntegrationEvent) {
			e.Payload = []byte(strings.Replace(string(e.Payload), `"plan_revision":1`, `"plan_revision":1,"plan_revision":1`, 1))
		},
		"null": func(e *IntegrationEvent) {
			e.Payload = []byte(strings.Replace(string(e.Payload), `"plan_revision":1`, `"plan_revision":null`, 1))
		},
		"trailing": func(e *IntegrationEvent) { e.Payload = append(e.Payload, []byte(` {}`)...) },
		"oversize": func(e *IntegrationEvent) { e.Payload = append(e.Payload, []byte(strings.Repeat(" ", 8192))...) },
		"unknown data": func(e *IntegrationEvent) {
			e.Payload = []byte(strings.Replace(string(e.Payload), `"plan_revision":1`, `"plan_revision":1,"score":100`, 1))
		},
		"event id": func(e *IntegrationEvent) {
			e.Payload = []byte(strings.Replace(string(e.Payload), e.EventID, e.StudentID, 1))
			e.EventID = e.StudentID
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			bad := event
			bad.Payload = append(json.RawMessage(nil), event.Payload...)
			mutate(&bad)
			if ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(bad) == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid stored event admitted")
			}
		})
	}
}
